title: Greatclub

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 Bludgeoning, 5 ft melee. Simple, two-handed and dippable.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. A melee weapon hit forces a Constitution save against hybrid DC or Dazes for 2 turns. Dazed removes the Dexterity bonus to AC, imposes disadvantage on Wisdom saves and blocks reactions that spend the Reaction resource. Help can end it.
fields.Tenacity: While main-handed, on a missed melee attack use your Reaction to deal Strength modifier Bludgeoning, minimum 1. It does not apply a missed weapon action’s effect.
fields.Acquisition: The pinned item does not document a specific acquisition location.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
